headline: 百鎊球鞋的反彈潮
context: 球鞋圈開始對三位數英鎊的價格反彈。從九零年代定價 110 英鎊、由 Sergio Lozano 設計的 Nike Air Max 95，到如今動輒 250 英鎊的鞋款，有專欄寫道：球鞋迷正在重新發現，便宜的鞋也可以一樣有魅力。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: From Nike’s infamous 110s to £250 and back again, sneakerheads are rediscovering why cheaper shoes can be worth just as much hype as much more expensive ones • Don’t get Fashion Statement delivered to your inbox? Sign up here When Nike’s Air Max 95 trainers first landed in Britain back in the mid-1990s, they looked unlike anything else. Created by footwear designer Sergio Lozano, the shoe had wavy layers running down its sides, neon yellow accents, and visible ‘Air’ bubbles underfoot. But in the UK, one detail quickly became as famous as the shoe itself: its £110 price tag. The Air Max 95 immediately picked up the nickname “110” because spending £110 on trainers seemed outrageous at the time. Owning a pair quickly became a status symbol among young men across Britain , while in celebrity circles they were worn by everyone from Jay-Z to Kylie Minogue. Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘If I’m spending that kind of money, the shoe has to do everything’ – the backlash to the three figure trainer

claim_trace.claim: 專欄指球鞋迷對三位數英鎊價格出現反彈，重新擁抱平價鞋款。
claim_trace.source_title: ‘If I’m spending that kind of money, the shoe has to do everything’ – the backlash to the three figure trainer

thread_text:
球鞋圈對三位數價格的反彈正在成形。九零年代中期，Sergio Lozano 設計的 Nike Air Max 95 在英國以 110 英鎊登場，價格本身就成了話題；如今鞋價動輒 250 英鎊，有專欄指出，球鞋迷正在重新發現：便宜的鞋，也可以跟貴的一樣值得追。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 21 日發佈的專欄。
threads_text:
「如果我要花這種錢，這雙鞋就得什麼都辦得到。」球鞋圈對三位數英鎊價格的反彈，正在成形。回頭看九零年代中期：Sergio Lozano 設計的 Nike Air Max 95 在英國登場，波浪層次、螢光黃點綴、看得見的氣墊——但最出名的細節，是它 110 英鎊的定價。如今球鞋動輒 250 英鎊，有專欄觀察到一個轉向：球鞋迷正在重新發現，便宜的鞋也可以一樣有魅力。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 21 日發佈的專欄，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
voice_text: 球鞋太貴，連鞋迷都開始反彈了。九零年代中期，Nike 的 Air Max 95 在英國賣 110 英鎊，那個價格本身就是話題。現在呢？動輒 250 英鎊。有專欄觀察到一個轉向——球鞋迷正在重新發現，便宜的鞋，也可以一樣有魅力。這是一篇專欄觀察，聽聽就好。
